setup.text: The forge yard is quiet and the centerpiece's frame stands finished. Ilsa has laid her tools in a wide arc around the empty socket. She sets a river stone upon the anvil. "This is a start."

option_a.text: The player hands over a river stone. Ilsa turns it once in the light and sets to work on it. "This will do."

option_b.text: The player casts temper over the heated stone. It sets true on the first pass, and Ilsa checks the edge with her thumb.

option_c.text:
The player asks, "Waiting on something?"

Ilsa does not look up. "It'll turn up."
